value.name: Rate limit dynamic paths (log only)
value.description: Bot policy 2026-11-03, T5: log any IP making more than 120 requests a minute to the pages rendered per request (/events, /societies, /request, /sign-in and their .rsc), the talks pillar or /api/. Log mode: measure before refusing anything; switch the rate limit's action to deny only after reading the logs.
